items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: So, he said, well, I have a buffet you can use and take it out to the factory and have it fixed.

ctx.x: There were a lot of them in those days. Oh, yeah. Did you ever use a buffet? Buffet?

Yeah. I was using a buffet because the one that I, this Selma client that I bought in France, it cracked on him, see? I had to have it fixed. So, it happened to, I was also using a penzamala when I was waiting at the cafe. So, Jimmy Dawson came in the place one night. So, the penzamala company gave him the clarinet, see? So, he came in and he wanted to sit down and play. I said, well, I don't know. I said, I'm using a penzamala and I said, this thing is in bad shape. So, he said, well, I have a buffet you can use…
Did you ever use an A clarinet or just everything on B flat usually?
